title: Cooperative reading of DECA-CCAAT composite element by the TALE/NF-Y/Sp2 transcription factors.
authors: Bernardini, Andrea; Gnesutta, Nerina; Mantovani, Roberto
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold建模TALE/NF-Y/Sp2在DECA-CCAAT复合元件上的协同结合结构，聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，方法为AI结构预测，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: To understand how genes are regulated it is important to assess the molecular basis of TFs cooperation in promoter and enhancer regulatory elements. Compelling genetic, genomic and biochemical data in mammals and zebrafish point at DECA-CCAAT composite elements as important for regulation of gene expression in development. DECA is recognized by the homeodomain (HD) heterodimeric TALE TFs (PBX/PREP), CCAAT by the NF-Y trimer. Both are evolutionarily conserved in eukaryotes, including plants. Sp2, a member of the Sp/KLF family, potentiates association of TALE and NF-Y on DNA. We applied AlphaFold to infer the structural basis of the hexameric complex with DNA. The resulting models position TALE and NF-Y on the respective sites, predicting the complex arrangement of the MEINOX/PBC heterodimerization module of the TALE TFs and the sequence-specific DNA contacts of the HDs to DECA. The complex is tied by the Sp2 N-terminus, which contacts the TALE dimer through the alpha-helical SP-box and the NF-Y trimer through a novel short linear motif (YA-SLiM). A flexible linker separates the anchor points, consistent with the constrained stereo-alignment of the DECA-CCAAT motif. The models are confirmed by assembly of the recombinant NF-Y/TALE/Sp2 in complex with DNA in vitro. Mutagenesis confirms the importance of the SP-box and YA-SLiM for cooperativity. Rationalising available genomic and biochemical data, the structural models depict a novel mode of cooperative binding on DNA, providing important clues as to how TFs potentially function beyond DECA-CCAAT in different eukaryotic contexts.
abstract_zh: 为了理解基因如何被调控，评估转录因子（TFs）在启动子和增强子调控元件中协同作用的分子基础至关重要。在哺乳动物和斑马鱼中，令人信服的遗传学、基因组学和生物化学数据指出，DECA-CCAAT复合元件在发育过程中对基因表达调控具有重要意义。DECA由同源异型域（HD）异二聚体TALE转录因子（PBX/PREP）识别，CCAAT由NF-Y三聚体识别。两者在真核生物（包括植物）中进化上保守。Sp2，作为Sp/KLF家族成员，增强TALE和NF-Y在DNA上的结合。我们应用AlphaFold推断六聚体复合物与DNA结合的结构基础。所得模型将TALE和NF-Y定位在各自位点上，预测了TALE转录因子的MEINOX/PBC异二聚化模块的复合排列以及HDs对DECA的序列特异性DNA接触。该复合物由Sp2 N端连接，其通过α-螺旋SP-box接触TALE二聚体，并通过一种新颖的短线性基序（YA-SLiM）接触NF-Y三聚体。一个柔性连接子分隔锚点，与DECA-CCAAT基序的受限立体对齐一致。这些模型通过重组NF-Y/TALE/Sp2与DNA在体外形成复合物得到验证。突变分析确认了SP-box和YA-SLiM对协同作用的重要性。通过合理化现有基因组学和生物化学数据，结构模型描绘了一种新的DNA协同结合模式，为转录因子在不同真核生物背景下可能超越DECA-CCAAT的功能提供了重要线索。
